turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hello, kya meri baat [Customer Name] ji se ho rahi hai?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan main hi bol raha hoon. Kaun bol rahe hain aap aur kis silsile mein call kiya hai?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hello sir, main Riya baat kar rahi hoon Kosha Finance se. Maine aapko ek pre-approved personal loan offer ke baare mein batane ke liye call kiya hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Pre-approved? Achha... actually main thoda home renovation ke liye soch raha tha. Kitne tak ka loan mil raha hai aur interest rate kya hoga?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text:
Home renovation ke liye yeh offer ekdum perfect hai sir, hum aapko ₹3,00,000 tak ka loan provide kar rahe hain. 
Iska interest rate 13% per annum se shuru hota hai, jo aapke profile par depend karega.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mujhe waise 2 lakh ke aas paas hi chahiye. Par pehle yeh batao ki rate fixed rahega ya badlega? Aur processing fee kitni lagegi exactly?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text:
Sir, ₹2 lakh ka amount bilkul mil jayega aur rate aapke tenure ke dauran fixed rahega. 
Processing fee sirf up to 2% plus GST hoti hai, jo ki kaafi transparent hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Achha, 2% plus GST... aur iske alawa koi hidden charges toh nahi hain na? Jaise foreclosure fee ya prepayment charges?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text:
Nahi sir, Kosha Finance mein koi hidden charges nahi hain aur sab kuch ekdum clear hota hai. 
Agar aap chahein toh main aapko application link SMS ya WhatsApp par bhej doon taaki aap aage ka process check kar sakein?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Teekh hai, aap mujhe WhatsApp par link bhej dijiye. Main pehle saari details dhang se padh leta hoon, fir aage apply karne ka sochungaa.
